description: Following Mast's lead, Anchor dons her custom swimsuit and steps in as a "Maid for a Day." Her skills, honed through experiences from various fundraisers aboard the Admire, rival those of a professional maid.

levels.name: Starfish (Shaped) Omurice
levels.description:
■ Activates when entering Full Burst. Affects all allies.
<color=#00AEFF>Effects vary according to the number of times used. <word_group=10028>Each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it</word_group>:
Once: Healing ▲ 18.29% for 5 sec.
Twice: <word_group=10019>Distributed Damage</word_group> ▲ 17.96% for 10 sec.
Three times: Decreases the <word_group=10068>stack count of stackable debuffs</word_group> by 1.</color>
■ Activates when entering Full Burst if an ally from the same squad is present. Affects all allies.

lines.text: Huh? Weren't we going out to sea?
So, I'm calling you Master now, not Captain. Got it!

Being a maid is easier than I thought. 
Should I make you some omurice?
You must really like maid cafes, Master. You go there quite often.
I'll give you a massage as a special service.

Become tastier! Coochie woochie, boing♡
... Would you prefer if I acted a bit more embarrassed?
Oh, a starfish!
I also enjoy just doing nothing like this with you, Master.
Were there always this many maids at the Outpost?
Hold on, I'm busy right now. I'm picking up signals from marine life!

Oh right, I was supposed to go to the Maid Cafe...
Can't I do this at the pool?

It's Anchor, at the Master's service and filled with romance!
... Mast told me to say that.
Thank you, Master.
I'm so happy, Master.
You're the best, Master. This turned out wonderfully.
Can a maid like me accept gifts?
Next time, I'll make you a starfish omurice on the house.
Even my starfish says thank you.
I enjoy just being with you, Master.
Hmm... Maybe becoming a maid was a good choice.
Hehe. I like this.
Are you calling me? Are we going to do some marine life exploration?
Hello, Master.
Hmm... These slippers are a bit...
Let's go, starfish.
You seem to really like maids, Master.
That dessert was delicious...
Hmm, I think I forgot the recipe.
Doo dee doo... Maid For You♪
Maybe Coral pancake, Sea Squirt Parfait?
The starfish decoration is so cool!
I'm ready, Master.
Would you like to try our signature menu?
Love Maid Power!
Sea Cucumber Pasta!
Sea Anemone Cake!
Sea Worm Omurice!
Ouch...
Ugh...
Hnnnk!
I... I'm a terrible maid.
So... this is how powerful maids can be...
